sloka: रावणेन एवम् उक्ता तु कुपिता जनक आत्मजा ।प्रत्युवाच अनवद्यांगी तम् अनादृत्य राक्षसम् ॥३-४७-३२॥
transliteration: rāvaṇena evam uktā tu kupitā janaka ātmajā ।pratyuvāca anavadyāṁgī tam anādṛtya rākṣasam ॥3-47-32॥

translations.english: Thus addressed by Ravana, Janaki, a lady of blemishless limbs, got enraged and replied without caring for the demon:
